A friend.

A home.

Someone weaker.

Something worth preserving.

Bubbles allowed her to contain.

Pressure allowed her to immobilize.

Rahim disappeared.

Ife has always been strongest when opposing forces are allowed to support one another.","backstory":"Ife was born from a contradiction.

Her body transformed conflict into equilibrium.

A sibling.

A friend.

A home.

Someone weaker.

Something worth preserving.

Bubbles allowed her to contain.

Pressure allowed her to immobilize.

Heat ensured that containment could become devastating whenever necessary.

Contain first. Protect first. Destroy only when necessary.

Rahim disappeared.

No attack she could block.

Character Summary
Ruchika is the Bone Dragon, born from Terrax, the living embodiment of Earth, and Leviathans, the living embodiment of Water. His element is not simply skeletal matter. Bone exists through him as the synthesis of Earth's mineral permanence and Water's living adaptability.
Calm, disciplined, intensely protective, and extraordinarily skilled as a craftsman, Ruchika specializes in creating living bone structures, fortifications, weapons, traps, armor, and entire dungeon environments.
His closest emotional bond is with his younger sister Ife, the Steam Dragon. Ruchika personally created the Bone Dragon Whip for her from his own living bone, designing it to survive and channel her superheated steam.
At some point in his story, Ruchika's memories were taken or disrupted by a spell, and he subsequently vanished. His current whereabouts remain unknown.

11 — Power System","backstory":"Ruchika grew into a dragon defined not by conquest, but construction.
He understood early that Earth and Water were not contradictory forces within him. Earth gave his creations structure. Water gave them life.
That realization transformed his Bone Magic into something unlike ordinary necromancy or skeletal manipulation.
Ruchika does not depend upon corpses.
He creates.
His own elemental essence can produce new bone matter, allowing him to build armor, weapons, barriers and enormous structures.

His craftsmanship reached its most personal expression through Ife.
Knowing his younger sister's Steam Magic could destroy conventional weapons, he crafted a whip using his own magically replicated tail-bone structure.
The weapon became one of the clearest demonstrations of how Ruchika expresses love: he builds something capable of keeping the person safe even when he cannot personally stand beside them.

11 — Power System","backstory":"Ruchika grew into a dragon defined not by conquest, but construction.
He understood early that Earth and Water were not contradictory forces within him. Earth gave his creations structure. Water gave them life.
That realization transformed his Bone Magic into something unlike ordinary necromancy or skeletal manipulation.
Ruchika does not depend upon corpses.

His own elemental essence can produce new bone matter, allowing him to build armor, weapons, barriers and enormous structures.

His craftsmanship reached its most personal expression through Ife.
Knowing his younger sister's Steam Magic could destroy conventional weapons, he crafted a whip using his own magically replicated tail-bone structure.
The weapon became one of the clearest demonstrations of how Ruchika expresses love: he builds something capable of keeping the person safe even when he cannot personally stand beside them.

11 — Power System","backstory":"Ruchika grew into a dragon defined not by conquest, but construction.
He understood early that Earth and Water were not contradictory forces within him. Earth gave his creations structure. Water gave them life.
That realization transformed his Bone Magic into something unlike ordinary necromancy or skeletal manipulation.
Ruchika does not depend upon corpses.
He creates.
His own elemental essence can produce new bone matter, allowing him to build armor, weapons, barriers and enormous structures.
Eventually, Ruchika became associated with dungeon creation. His dungeons were not crude caves filled with traps. They were carefully engineered living environments capable of shifting passages, repairing broken structures and responding to intruders.
His craftsmanship reached its most personal expression through Ife.
Knowing his younger sister's Steam Magic could destroy conventional weapons, he crafted a whip using his own magically replicated tail-bone structure.
The weapon became one of the clearest demonstrations of how Ruchika expresses love: he builds something capable of keeping the person safe even when he cannot personally stand beside them.
Later, catastrophe struck.
A spell damaged or removed Ruchika's memories.
He vanished afterward.
Where the Bone Dragon currently resides—and how much of himself he remembers—remains an unresolved part of his story.

A home.

Something worth preserving.

Bubbles allowed her to contain.

Pressure allowed her to immobilize.

Contain first. Protect first. Destroy only when necessary.

No attack she could block.

With Leviathans

The relationship is quieter and more fluid, reflecting patience, understanding, and Ife's connection to the other half of her elemental identity.

With Rahim

Protection becomes worry.

His disappearance represents something Ife cannot simply solve with strength.

With Ruchika

Protection becomes trust.

The Bone Dragon Whip physically represents that bond.

With Ezra

Affection frequently disguises itself as irritation and competition.

They can annoy each other tremendously while remaining fiercely loyal siblings.

With Ash

There is currently only an unknown blood connection.

The relationship itself has not begun yet.

That distinction is important.

Blood may make Ash her brother.

It does not automatically create trust, familiarity, or emotional intimacy.

Those things must develop after they meet.

Ife's Relationship Pattern

Ife tends to become the guardian within relationships.

She remembers people's needs.

She notices danger.

She intervenes.

She places herself between threats and people she loves.

But this creates one recurring problem:

Ife is much better at protecting people than allowing people to protect her.

Her strongest relationships will eventually challenge that habit.

The people closest to Ife should not merely become individuals standing behind her protection.

They should become the people willing to step forward and stand beside her.

That distinction is essential to her emotional development.

Her body transformed conflict into equilibrium.

A friend.

A home.

Someone weaker.

Something worth preserving.

Bubbles allowed her to contain.

Pressure allowed her to immobilize.

Heat ensured that containment could become devastating whenever necessary.

Rahim disappeared.

No attack she could block.

She produced steam.

Her body transformed conflict into equilibrium.

His children were not protected from those expectations.

They participated in them.

Ife learned to fight because her father expected his children to understand their own strength.

But she never developed Ignis's fascination with combat for combat's sake.

She became a defender.

A sibling.

A friend.

A home.

Someone weaker.

Something worth preserving.

That instinct eventually shaped her unusual fighting style.

Steam allowed her to obscure.

Bubbles allowed her to contain.

Pressure allowed her to immobilize.

Heat ensured that containment could become devastating whenever necessary.

Then Ruchika gave her the weapon that completed the style.

The Bone Dragon Whip gave Ife reach.

Her powers and personality became reflections of one another.

Contain first. Protect first. Destroy only when necessary.

Rahim disappeared.

There was no enemy for her to bind.

No attack she could block.

No battlefield where she could simply stand between her brother and danger.

Her body transformed conflict into equilibrium.

A sibling.

A friend.

A home.

Someone weaker.

Something worth preserving.

Bubbles allowed her to contain.

Pressure allowed her to immobilize.

Heat ensured that containment could become devastating whenever necessary.

Contain first. Protect first. Destroy only when necessary.

Rahim disappeared.

No attack she could block.
